reuse.why: Routes the five inline midpoint copies through the existing getScheduledAmount, but the new API field gets its own getExpectedScheduleAmount that re-implements the missing/number/range dispatch instead of calling that helper.

duplication.why: The range rule (Math.min of the endpoints) and the missing-amount case are written twice, in getScheduledAmount and in api-models' getExpectedScheduleAmount.

placement.why: The approximate-amount rule lives only in server/api-models.ts, so the planning code in shared/schedules.ts (forecast, posting, previews, templates) never applies it; the rule belongs in the shared helper.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the amount rule, its call sites and the API field.

maintainability.why: Two definitions of the expected amount now disagree (approximate amounts handled only in the API) and the schedule-template call passes an opaque `op !== 'isbetween'` as a rounding flag.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/api-models.ts getExpectedScheduleAmount computes the expected amount itself instead of calling shared getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount in api-models.ts restates getScheduledAmount's null/number/range logic under a new name with the approximate case bolted on.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gained a round flag (and a rounding branch) used only by schedule-template; api-models bypasses the helper with its own definition.
